criteria.reason: Resolution right in all four cases, but {trd:false} prints `publish: off (ensemble.publishArtifacts.trd is false)` instead of `publish: off (set false for trd in publishArtifacts)`.
criteria.statement: An object setting naming a kind with a boolean decides that kind: `{"prd": true}` makes `--kind prd` print `publish: on`; `{"trd": false}` makes `--kind trd` print `publish: off (set false for trd in publishArtifacts)`; a kind the object does not name, or names with a non-boolean value, falls back to its default
criteria.cites: Intended Change, After item 1 (lines 15-16, the reason string), item 2 (lines 18-19: "object naming `K` with a boolean → that value; otherwise `PUBLISH_DEFAULTS[K]`")

criteria.reason: All 12 non-design publishing commands carry the rule: a non-zero exit or a missing `publish:` line reads as off, never on, and adds the ISSUES line "publish setting could not be read: <stderr>". The design contract treats both cases as off with that reason and ends STUCK, which matches design commands ending STUCK when off (FS-19).
criteria.statement: A resolver call that exits non-zero, or whose output has no `publish:` line, is treated as `publish: off` and adds one ISSUES line reading "publish setting could not be read: <stderr>" — never as on
criteria.cites: Intended Change, After item 3 (lines 25-27)

criteria.reason: Every publishing command that has a record step passes `--url ""` when publishing is off and the returned URL when it is on. audit-docs keeps no artifacts.json record of its change set, so it cannot leave a stale link. design-system and the design contract end STUCK with no publish when off, and the contract records `--url ""` for a kind that reads off, so design-system's unconditional record only ever follows a real republish.
criteria.statement: On `publish: off`, every publishing command's record step passes `--url ""`, so no later step republishes to or reads owner comments from a stale link; on `publish: on` the record step passes the published URL as before
